name: agents-workflow
description: General Agents Workflow Framework with Protocol Artifact Factory and Declarative Injection Engine
onboarding: [Pre-flight] Initialize default workflow paths (plans/, docs/, roadmap/, archived/): python yscb.py agents-workflow init --default -y
[Pre-flight] Enable target IDE environment (e.g. antigravity, claude, codex): python yscb.py agents-workflow release-target --add antigravity --proj
Publish AGENTS.md & skills to project workspace: python yscb.py agents-workflow release
